# Cristian Camilo Moreno Narváez (CCMN)

> Personal site: profile, portfolio, and bilingual blog (EN/ES) on data science, ML, BI, computer vision, and economics. Static Jekyll on GitHub Pages. No server-side LLM calls.

Preferred canonical host: https://ccamilocristian.github.io/ (no www).

## Primary surfaces

- [Home / Command Center](https://ccamilocristian.github.io/): profile + portfolio + blog entry
- [Profile](https://ccamilocristian.github.io/tabs/profile/): CV narrative, experience, skills
- [Blog / Intelligence](https://ccamilocristian.github.io/tabs/intelligence/): English listing of posts (Spanish alternates via search + in-post switcher)
- [Sitemap](https://ccamilocristian.github.io/sitemap.xml)
- [RSS](https://ccamilocristian.github.io/feed.xml)
